title: Trellus How-to Guides
summary: Browse practical Trellus guides for CRM setup, dialing skills, parallel dialing, callbacks and troubleshooting. Choose the task you need to finish.
body_markdown:
**How-to Guides**


Choose the task you need to finish. These Trellus guides cover preparing a calling workflow, choosing its pace, keeping follow-up usable and investigating problems. Start with the relevant existing guide rather than reading them in a required order.


## New in the daily How-to Guides series


[Check your microphone and headset before a calling session](https://www.trellus.ai/post/check-microphone-headset-before-calling) — inspect computer input/output, app and browser access, then use a local readiness worksheet. This link is released with the guide, not a promise of future content.


The sections below collect established resources published before this series. Their original URLs and publication histories are unchanged.


## Getting started


- [Add an auto dialer to your CRM](https://www.trellus.ai/post/crm-with-auto-dialer) — prepare one list, decide on call outcomes and callbacks, and use the first-session worksheet.
- [Evaluate a dialer in a one-week pilot](https://www.trellus.ai/post/sales-dialer-pilot-checklist) — define what the pilot must prove and inspect the saved results before deciding whether to buy.


## Dialing skills


- [Test a cold-call opener](https://www.trellus.ai/post/test-cold-call-opener) — compare openings around a defined question rather than treating a few conversations as a guaranteed winner.
- [Keep coaching useful without a call recording](https://www.trellus.ai/post/coach-sales-call-without-recording) — practice a specific moment without inventing what happened in an unrecorded call.


## Parallel dialing


- [Run an Attio call block](https://www.trellus.ai/post/how-to-run-an-attio-call-block) — prepare a People list, choose the pace and finish the conversation with useful follow-up. Includes power and parallel dialing in the Attio walkthrough.
- [Choose a mode during CRM setup](https://www.trellus.ai/post/crm-with-auto-dialer) — use the mode-selection section of the setup guide before expanding the session.


## CRM workflows


- [Switch dialers without stranding callbacks](https://www.trellus.ai/post/switch-dialers-preserve-callbacks) — reconcile promises and ownership before moving the working list.
- [Check what a save acknowledgment proves](https://www.trellus.ai/learning-center/crm-save-acknowledgment-record-evidence) — distinguish an attempted save from the information found on the destination record.


## Troubleshooting


- [Diagnose a stalled call block](https://www.trellus.ai/post/diagnose-stalled-call-block) — separate list exhaustion, research, conversations, after-call work and a failed workflow.


For the supported starting screen and platform-specific behavior, open the[integration directory](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations) . To discuss your own setup, bring the relevant worksheet to a[Trellus demo](https://www.trellus.ai/autodialer) .
